comment: M2 task 15 measured-then-frozen pins (check-format.sh). adversarial: the deterministic seeded corpus fmt_diff --gen emits — exact line count + sha256 (splitmix64-seeded, byte-stable by construction; a drifting corpus means the generator changed and the pin must be consciously re-frozen). capturedUniqueMin: the unique-double floor for the capture extraction — 26478 = the g01 player+article baseline (the cold-run minimum; a full build/ dir yields ~249k across all specs, and MORE capture files can only add). composite: exact case counts for the g01-derived composite file (captures are byte-stable across runs — check-player-model.sh/check-article-replay.sh — so these are exact, not minima): every player post snapshot (7200), every article args + post envelope (14636 + 14499), one full frame envelope per frame (3600), a synthetic 4-slot envelope every 100th frame (36), and 760 envelopes carrying a live non-empty articles queue (753 per-frame + 7 of the 4-slot ones; g01's 27 fox lasers over their lifetimes).
